name: Omoliday
author: Francois Stander
description: Omarchy's clock and calendar with public holidays marked: a dot under the day, the name on hover, dates from Nager.Date for your country.

barWidget.description: Clock and calendar with public holidays

schema.label: Country
schema.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as ZA. Empty follows the system locale; off shows no holidays and sends no requests.

schema.label: Region
schema.description: Optional subdivision code such as DE-BY, adding that region's public holidays to the nationwide ones.
